records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended July 3, 2021, 37% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The change in twelve-month backlog at July 3, 2021 as compared with the twelve-month backlog at June 27, 2020 was driven by increases across all markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Backlog increased in Aircraft Controls due to the timing of commercial aircraft orders and additional military development programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin increased in the third quarter and through the first three quarters of 2021 compared to the same periods of 2020 due to the absence of last year's $19 million COVID-19 related inventory write-down in the third quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our available borrowing capacity and our cash flow from operations have provided us with the financial resources needed to make organic investments, fund acquisitive growth and return capital to shareholders.
